# Poe2RitualWindow

[API index](../index.md)

A frame-bound view of the currently rooted Ritual window.

## IsVisible

```typescript
IsVisible: boolean;
```

## Element

```typescript
Element: Element | null;
```

The real rooted UI element. Null means the window/root is unavailable for this frame.

## Tribute

```typescript
Tribute: number | null;
```

Current native Tribute balance. Zero is a valid successful read; null means unavailable.

## Rewards

```typescript
Rewards: Poe2RitualReward[] | null;
```

Current ordinary-mode Ritual rewards. An open or closed readable empty window yields `[]`;
null means the reward observation is unreadable or unsupported. See ReadError.

## ReadError

```typescript
ReadError: string | null;
```

Passive cached result of the last relevant native read attempt.
